title: Other Mommy

text.lead:
Other Mommy is a 2026 American supernatural psychological horror film directed by Rob Savage and written by Nathan Elston. The film is based on the 2024 novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman. It stars Jessica Chastain as a mother who must do everything to protect her daughter (played by Arabella Olivia Clark) from a supernatural entity that resembles her. Jay Duplass, Dichen Lachman, Arian Moayed, and Karen Allen make up the supporting cast. James Wan serves as a producer through his Blumhouse – Atomic Monster banner, in association with Spin a Black Yarn.
Filming for Other Mommy took place in Dublin, Ireland from May to July of 2025. It was released in the United States by Universal Pictures on October 9, 2026. The film received negative reviews from critics.
text.plot:
Seven-year-old Isabela Martin, nicknamed Bela, struggles to adjust to a new school and the growing distance between her parents: Ursula, who is consumed by her corporate career, and Russell, nicknamed Russ, who is an unemployed househusband and spends much of his time caring for Bela at home. She begins encountering a supernatural entity resembling her mother. Bela calls it Other Mommy, and it repeatedly asks to be let into her heart.
The encounters become increasingly frightening as Other Mommy follows Bela beyond her bedroom, changes its shape, and distorts the space around it. At a family party, it seemingly makes every guest disappear, lifts Bela to the ceiling, and attempts to force its way into her. Bela punches it away and falls back into the crowded room. Realizing the danger, her parents take her to stay with Ursula's friend Frank.
At Frank's house, Bela discovers Ursula's contact lens case, leading Russ to suspect that Ursula is having an affair with Frank. That night, Other Mommy exploits the family's tensions and manipulates Bela into wishing Frank out of their lives. It then kills Frank in front of the family, surviving the gunshots he fires at it. They flee to a mall restaurant, but Other Mommy attacks again, transporting Bela from the play area to her bedroom and then to a lake beneath a hilltop mansion. The entity tells Bela that Ursula never wanted her to exist before returning her to the family's car. Her parents take her to the home of her grandmother, Ruth, who has experience fighting ghosts.
Ruth shelters the family and hires ghost investigators, who identify Other Mommy as a trickster demon seeking to "carnate" into Bela and take over her life. However, it cannot do so without her permission. As the investigators prepare their equipment, Ruth tells Bela that pain is an unavoidable part of life. The team's séance summons Other Mommy, but the investigators prove powerless against it and are killed. The family escapes again as the entity threatens Bela.
Determined to stop running, the family returns home to confront Other Mommy. Their weapons prove ineffective, forcing them to barricade themselves in the basement. There, Ursula admits that she never wanted to have Bela and initially viewed the pregnancy as a loss of freedom, but insists that she loves her daughter and wants to care for her. She also reveals that Russ is not Bela's biological father: Ursula was married to another man when she met Russ and began an affair with him.
Ursula's confession appears to weaken Other Mommy, but it upsets Bela, who runs to her bedroom and begs the entity to enter her heart. Other Mommy appears and promises that Bela will never experience pain again. Remembering Ruth's lesson, Bela rejects the promise and attacks the entity, repeatedly denying it permission until it is defeated.
Months later, Bela, Ursula, and Russ happily hang Christmas lights together. However, Bela notices signs that Ursula's unhappiness is returning.
text.cast:
- Jessica Chastain as Ursula Martin, Bela's mother
- Chastain also portrays the "Other Mommy", a supernatural entity
- Arabella Olivia Clark as Isabela "Bela" Martin, a young girl targeted by the Other Mommy
- Jay Duplass as Russell "Russ" Martin, Bela's father and Ursula's husband
- Dichen Lachman as Lois, an exorcist
- Arian Moayed as Frank
- Karen Allen as Grandma Ruth Martin, Ursula's mother and Bela's grandmother
- Sean Kaufman as Kelvin
- Adam Silver
- Rosie Anne O’Gorman
text.production: In April 2025, it was announced that an adaptation of the novel Incidents Around the House was in development, with Rob Savage directing, Nathan Elston writing the screenplay, and Jessica Chastain starring in the lead role. In May, Jay Duplass joined the cast. Principal photography took place in Dublin, Ireland between May 12 and July 9, 2025. Dichen Lachman joined the cast in the following month. In July, Arabella Olivia Clark, Sean Kaufman, Adam Silver, Rosie Anne O'Gorman and Karen Allen were added to the cast with the film being retitled to Other Mommy.
text.release: Other Mommy was released in the United States on October 9, 2026. The film was previously scheduled to release on May 8, 2026.
text.reception:
The film was panned by critics. On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, 18% of 56 critics' reviews are positive, with an average rating of 4.5/10. The website's consensus reads: "Despite a valiant turn from Jessica Chastain as the spectral embodiment of a smothering parent, Other Mommy proves too silly for its intermittently effective jump scares to add up to a spooky whole." Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned the film a score of 39 out of 100, based on 11 critics, indicating "generally unfavorable" reviews. Audiences polled by CinemaScore gave the film an average grade of "D+" on an A+ to F scale.
The New York Times called the film a "sometimes-creepy, sometimes-hilarious schlockfest", and questions "What is the other mommy supposed to be?"
